title: AI Workloads and Scenarios

header.html: Identify scenarios for common AI workloads, including generative and agentic AI, text analysis, speech, computer vision, and information extraction
the official AI-901 study guide, skills measured as of April 15, 2026

html:
1The six workloads

An AI workload is a kind of problem that AI solves. The exam gives a business scenario and asks which workload it is. Learn each one with its input, output and a typical example.

Workload Input Output Example scenario
Generative AI A prompt (text, sometimes images or audio) New text, code, images or audio Write a product description; answer questions in a chat
Agentic AI A goal and instructions Actions taken with tools, then a result An assistant that looks up an order, checks stock and replies
Text analysis Text Facts about the text: key phrases, entities, sentiment, summary Find what customers complain about in reviews
Speech Spoken audio, or text Text from audio, or audio from text Transcribe a meeting; read a message aloud
Computer vision Images or video Captions, tags, objects, text in images Describe a photo; read a street sign
Information extraction Documents, images, audio, video Structured fields (JSON) or searchable text Pull invoice number, date and total from invoices

2Generative AI

Generative AI creates content from a prompt.

  • Text: draft email, summarize, translate, answer, write code.
  • Images: create a picture from a description.
  • The result is new, not looked up. It can be wrong (Module 2), so grounding and review matter.

3Agentic AI

An AI agent is a software application built on generative AI with three parts:

Part Meaning
A large language model The "brain" that reasons about the request
Instructions A system prompt that defines the agent's role and behavior
Tools What the agent can use: knowledge tools (search, files) and action tools (call an API, run code)

Agentic AI means the agent decides which tools to use and takes steps toward a goal, instead of only answering. Multi-agent systems have several agents that collaborate, each with its own specialty.

Exam tip

. Generative = produces content. Agentic = plans and acts with tools (look up, calculate, call a service). If the scenario says "checks the order status and updates the ticket", think agent.

4Text analysis

Text analysis (natural language processing) extracts meaning from existing text.

Technique Question it answers
Keyword (key phrase) extraction What are the main topics?
Entity detection Which people, places, organizations, dates and amounts are named?
Sentiment analysis Is the opinion positive, negative, neutral or mixed?
Summarization What is the short version?
Language detection Which language is this?
Exam tip

. Check the input and the output to pick the workload: text in, facts about it out is text analysis; text in, new text out is generative AI.

5Speech

Task Name Example
Audio to text Speech recognition (speech to text) Captions and meeting notes
Text to audio Speech synthesis (text to speech) A voice assistant reads the answer
Spoken language to another language Speech translation Live interpretation

6Computer vision

Computer vision understands images and video: describe a picture (caption), tag its contents, detect objects and their positions, read text in images (OCR), detect people. Image-generation models work the other way: they create an image from text.

7Information extraction

Information extraction turns unstructured content (documents, forms, images, audio, video) into structured data or text that can be searched. Example: receipts and invoices become fields such as vendor, date and total; call recordings become a transcript and a summary.

8Choose the workload

The scenario says Workload
"write", "draft", "chat", "create a picture" Generative AI (image creation = generative or image generation)
"decide which step to take and call the system" Agentic AI
"what do customers feel about…", "find names and dates in text" Text analysis
"transcribe", "read aloud", "voice commands" Speech
"describe the photo", "find the cars", "read the sign" Computer vision
"pull the total from invoices", "get fields from forms" Information extraction
Exam tip

. Check the input and output. Text in, facts about it out = text analysis. Text in, new text out = generative AI. Document in, fields out = information extraction.

9Exam Q&A

9.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants to learn whether thousands of product reviews are positive or negative. Which workload is this?

  • AText analysis
  • BSpeech synthesis
  • CComputer vision
  • DAgentic AI
Show the answer

Answer: A. Sentiment analysis is a text analysis technique.

S2The team wants an assistant that checks stock, looks up an order and then emails the customer by calling company systems. Which workload fits best?

  • AAgentic AI
  • BInformation extraction
  • CSpeech recognition
  • DComputer vision
Show the answer

Answer: A. An agent uses tools to take actions toward a goal.

S3A finance team wants invoice numbers, dates and totals pulled from scanned invoices into a database. Which workload is this?

  • AGenerative AI
  • BInformation extraction
  • CSpeech synthesis
  • DEntity recognition in speech
Show the answer

Answer: B. Turning documents into structured fields is information extraction.

S4A tablet app must read a news article aloud to a visually impaired user. Which capability is needed?

  • ASpeech synthesis
  • BSpeech recognition
  • CKey phrase extraction
  • DObject detection
Show the answer

Answer: A. Speech synthesis converts text to spoken audio.

S5A mobile app must identify the objects in a photo and say where each one is. Which workload is this?

  • AComputer vision
  • BText analysis
  • CSpeech translation
  • DSummarization
Show the answer

Answer: A. Object detection is a computer vision task.

S6A marketing team asks a model to write three slogan ideas for a new tent. Which workload is this?

  • AGenerative AI
  • BInformation extraction
  • CLanguage detection
  • DSpeech recognition
Show the answer

Answer: A. Creating new text from a prompt is generative AI.

9.2 Recall questions

R1Name the six workloads in this module.

Show the answer

Generative AI, agentic AI, text analysis, speech, computer vision, information extraction.

R2What three parts make an AI agent?

Show the answer

A large language model, instructions and tools.

R3What are the two kinds of agent tools?

Show the answer

Knowledge tools and action tools.

R4Speech recognition turns what into what?

Show the answer

Spoken audio into text.

R5Which workload outputs structured fields from documents?

Show the answer

Information extraction.

R6What does a multi-agent system have?

Show the answer

Several agents that collaborate, each with its own specialty.

10Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Generative AI creates new content from a prompt
Agentic AI agent = model + instructions + tools; takes actions toward a goal
Text analysis keywords, entities, sentiment, summary, language
Speech recognition (audio to text), synthesis (text to audio), translation
Computer vision caption, tags, objects, OCR, people; image generation creates images
Information extraction documents, images, audio, video to structured fields or searchable text
